hook: A clause (条) plus a promise (約): a treaty is a list of promised clauses.
Help (助) with words (言): advice is helping someone by speaking.
New (新) entering (入) student (生): the freshman who just came in.
救 means save: すくい sounds like 'scoop', you scoop someone out of trouble.
澄 means clear, still water: すます, make things clear and quiet, like clearing your ears to listen.
Correct (正) solution (解): the right answer.
Sincerity (誠) that is real (実): an honest, faithful person.
Put in order (整) in a row (列): stand neatly in a line.
Make it right (是) and correct (正): fixing something that was wrong.
World or era (世) plus replace (代): each generation replaces the one before.
Set up (設) and place (置): install or establish something.
Set up (設) and fix (定): establishing how something will work, like creating its settings.
Run (走) plus go (行): a car running along the road.
Dress up (装) and decorate (飾): ornaments that make things pretty.
添 means add alongside: そえる, set something beside the main thing, like a side dish.
At once (即) from your seat (座): you act without even standing up, right away.
染 means dye: cloth そまる (gets dyed) when it soaks up the colour.
揃 means even and matching: そろい, things that all match, a matching set.
Big (大) money (金): a large sum.
Wait on (待) someone you meet (遇): how you treat people, or how a job treats you.
Big (大) part (部): the greater part, most of it.
Lazy (怠) and slack (慢): negligence, not doing your job.
Facing (対) face (面): meeting someone face to face.
Facing (対) talk (話): a dialogue between two people.
耐 means endure: たえる, to bear pain without breaking.
携 means carry in hand: たずさわる, to have your hands in some work.
漂 has water (氵) and means drift: ただよう, float on water or hang in the air.
A person (者) who has reached (達) a high level: skilful, or in good health.
保 means keep or protect: たもつ, to keep something as it is.
Short (短) spirit (気): a short temper.
Arrive (着) on land (陸): a plane landing.
Cut off (断) in the middle (中): an interruption.
Arrange (調) plus seal (印): putting your seal on an agreement, signing it.
Levy (徴) and collect (収): collecting taxes or fees.
Layered (重) and double (複): the same thing twice, overlapping.
A treasure (宝) you value highly (重): a handy thing you prize because it is so useful.
Passing through (通) always (常): the ordinary, usual way.
仕 (person 亻 plus 士) means serve: つかえる, to work for a master.
尽 means use up: つくす, give everything you have to a person or task.
造 means build: つくり, how something is built, its structure.
告 means announce: つげる, to tell someone news.
募 means recruit or collect: つのる, to call for people, help or money.
Hold up (提) and carry together (携): two companies joining hands.
Hold out (提) and show (示): present something, like showing your ID.
Revise (訂) to make correct (正): fixing a mistake.
Fixed (定) year (年): the set age when you retire.
Hand (手) plus base (元): what is near your hand, at hand.
Days (日) linked (連) together: every day in a row.
People linked (連) together among us (中): a group, that bunch.
詫 has 言 (words): わび, words to say sorry, an apology.
恥 is ear (耳) plus heart (心): your ears go red and your heart feels shame.
Break (破) and damage (損): something broken.
叩 has 口 (mouth) for the sound: はたく, hit, slap or dust off.
Basic quality (質) plus plain (素): a simple, modest, frugal way of living.
Real (実) state (態): the true situation.
Take in (収) profit (益): the money a business earns.
The many people's (衆) discussion (議) house (院): the Lower House.
End (終) and start (始): from beginning to end, all the way.
Layered (重) and double (複): じゅうふく is another reading of ちょうふく, overlap.
Celebrate (祝) and congratulate (賀): a celebration.
Main (主) body (体): the subject, the main actor.
Out (出) plus give birth (産): a baby comes out, childbirth.
Go out (出) to the company (社): go to work.
Quick (敏) feeling (感): sensitive, feels things fast.
Not (不) plus business mood (景気): hard times, a recession.
Not (不) clear after examining (審): doubtful, suspicious.
Not (不) swinging (振): no energy, a slump.
Again (復) plus rise up (興): a city rising again after a disaster.
Divide (分) and tear (裂): split apart.
Soldier (兵) tools (器): weapons.
Rich (豊) crop (作): a big harvest.
Repay (報) and reward (酬): payment for your work.
Stunned (呆) state (然): standing there amazed, unable to think.
Keep (保) and manage (管): store things safely.
Collect (募) money (金): fund raising.
Make up for (補) and help (助): support, assistance.
True (本) sound (音): your real feelings, what you truly mean.
Look (見) into (込): what you can see coming, the prospects.
満 means full: みたす, to fill up or satisfy.
乱 means disorder: みだす, to mess something up.
乱 means disorder: みだれる, to become messy or disturbed.
Near (近) your body (身): close to you, familiar.
Watch (見) and learn (習): learn by following someone's example.
How your body (身) is dressed up (なり): your clothes and appearance.
Around (回り) your body (身): your belongings and daily things.
Body (身) waving (振り): a gesture.
Look (見) across (渡): to look out over a wide view.
People's (民) customs (俗): folk traditions.
No (無) meaning (意味): nonsense.
No (無) mouth (口): a quiet person who says little.
Without (無) giving notice (断, as in 断る): without permission.
No (無) use (用): useless, not needed.
漏 has water (氵) and means leak: もらす, let water or a secret leak out.
Heap up (盛り) and rise (上がる): a party gets lively, a crowd swells.
House (屋) on spread out land (敷): a big house on wide grounds, a mansion.
Cheap (安) plus っぽい (like): it looks cheap.
Living (生) in the fields (野): wild.
病 means illness: やむ, to be ill.
有 means have: ゆうする, a formal way to say to own.
揺 means shake: ゆらぐ, to sway or waver.
緩 has 糸 (thread): ゆるむ, a thread loosens and goes slack.
Key (要) cause (因): the main factor.
Use (用) goods (品): supplies, things for a purpose.
Western (洋) style (風).
Before (予) feeling (感): a feeling about something before it happens.
Understand (了) and accept (承): OK, I acknowledge it.
Romance (恋) and love (愛): love between partners.
Shoot (射) back (反): light bouncing back, a reflection.
Judge (判) and decide (定): a verdict.
Evening (晩) years (年): the last years of a life.
Ten thousand (万) abilities (能): can do everything, all purpose.
控 means hold back: ひかえる, to hold yourself back, or note something down to keep.
Days (日) plus around the time (頃): usually, on ordinary days.
Slight (微) laugh (笑): a small smile.
Person (人) shadow (影): the figure of a person.
A person's (人) pattern (柄): personality, character.
Taking (取り) a day (日): choosing the date.
暦 contains 日 (day): こよみ, counting the days, a calendar.
Fur (毛 け) thing (もの), with an old だ in the middle: けだもの, a furry beast, a brute.
Fur (毛 け) thing (もの): けもの, a furry beast; 獣 has 犬 (dog) on the right.
Usually written 取り分け: take (取) one and separate (分) it from the rest, especially that one.
誠 is words (言) plus become (成): words that come true, truth and sincerity.
眉 is a picture of hair over an eye (目): the eyebrow.
股 has 月 (the body part radical): もも, the thigh.
矢 looks like an arrow with feathers: や, an arrow.
Sound (音) behind a gate (門): in darkness you can only hear, not see.
液 has water (氵): えき, liquid.
雄 has 隹 (bird) and means male: the showy bird is the male, おす.
賭 has 貝 (shell, old money): かけ, putting money on a bet.
粥 is rice (米) between two 弓 shapes: かゆ, soft rice porridge.
粋 has 米 (rice): the pure, best part of the rice, the essence.
魂 has 鬼 (ghost, spirit): the spirit inside you, your soul.
塵 is deer (鹿) over earth (土): dust kicked up by running deer.
罰 has a net (罒), words (言) and a knife (刂): caught and judged, punishment.
塾 has earth (土) at the bottom: a small private school on your street, cram school.
油 has water (氵) and means oil: ゆ after a word names an oil, like 石油 (oil from rock).
症 has 疒 (the sickness radical): しょう after a word names a disease, like 花粉症.
干 means dry: ほし before a food means dried, like 干し柿 (dried persimmon).
掛 means hang: a bill left hanging (掛け) to pay later is credit.
署 means government office: しょ after a word, like 警察署 (police station).
派 means branch or faction: は after a word means a group, like 反対派 (the opposing side).
宛 means address to: あて after a name means the letter is for that person.
掛 means hang: かけ after a word is a thing to hang it on, like 帽子掛け (hat rack).
網 has 糸 (thread) and means net: もう after a word means network, like 通信網.
著 means write a book: ちょ after a name means written by that person.
増 means increase: まし after an amount means that much more, like 二割増し (20% more).
狂 has 犭 (dog) and means crazy: きょう after a word means a mad fan, like 野球狂.
嬢 has 女 (woman): じょう after a name means young lady, Miss.
宗 means religion: しゅう after a name means a sect, like 禅宗 (Zen sect).
Seeing (見) from your ground (地): the spot you look from, a point of view.
Limit (限) and fix (定): limited, like a limited edition.
Original (原) book (典): the source text.
Atom (原, short for 原子) plus explode (爆): an atomic bomb.
Strict (厳) and close (密): exact, precise.
Wise (賢) and bright (明): a smart choice.
Thrifty (倹) plus cut down (約): saving money.
Raw (原) oil (油): crude oil.
Combine (兼) uses (用): one thing with two uses.
Authority (権) and power (力): political power.
Speech (言) and argument (論): free speech and discussion.
Words (語) collected (彙): vocabulary.
恋 has heart (心) at the bottom: こいする, to be in love.
Liking (好) feeling (意): kindness, good will.
Making things (工) study (学): engineering.
Resist (抗) plus discuss (議): a protest, speaking against something.
Discuss (議) together (合): a meeting to decide together.
Good (好) situation (況): a strong economy.
Ore (鉱) industry (業): mining.
Raise up (興) a business (業): starting new industry.
High (高) plain (原): a plateau.
Cross (交) each other (互): taking turns, alternate.
Thinking about (考) old things (古) study (学): archeology.
Craft (工) making (作): handicrafts, or secret maneuvering.
Plough (耕) and make (作): farming.
Ore (鉱) mountain (山): a mine.
Lecture (講) and learn (習): a short training course.
Mouth (口) states (述): saying it out loud.
Hold back (控) and remove (除): money taken off, a tax deduction.
High (高) and esteemed (尚): noble, refined.
Go (行) forward (進): a march, a parade.
Fragrant (香) spicy (辛) ingredients (料): spices.
Falling (降) water (水): rain and snow.
Vast (洪) water (水): a flood.
Combine (合) and make (成): synthetic.
Public (公) manner (然): openly, in front of everyone.
Resist (抗) and fight (争): a dispute.
Build (構) an idea (想): a plan in your mind.
Back (後) plus retreat (退): going backward.
Light (光) plus gloss (沢): a shiny finish.
Public (公) group (団): a public corporation.
Good (好) condition (調): going well.
Mouth (口) plus head (頭): spoken, oral.
Lecture (講) on reading (読): reading and explaining a text.
Buy (購) to read (読): a subscription.
Public (公) approval (認): official recognition.
Light (光) and heat (熱) cost (費): the electricity and gas bill.
Buy (購) and buy (買): purchasing.
Exchange (交) and give (付): handing over documents.
Public (公) call (募): asking the public for applicants or money.
Skilful (巧) and clever (妙): ingenious.
